visualization: ranked table sorted by visible rank score with AP/AUPRC-style score
interpretation: Operation-stack query-aware is often the AP-faithful ranking view, but fixed-session and dataset-native remain task-specific counterpoints.
Hot-group F1 is the most fragmented lens: raw-action, dataset-native, fixed-session, flat, and operation-stack each win at least one task.
Budgeted recall mostly favors operation stacks, but a width variant and dataset-native hierarchy win on boundary/safety tasks.

visualization: ranked drilldown to first positive operation
interpretation: First-positive search is a drilldown counterpoint: fixed-session or raw-action can surface an example earlier even when operation stacks rank better overall.

visualization: groups required to reach 50% positive recall
interpretation: Coverage at 50% positives often prefers raw-action or dataset-native groups, exposing mapping/depth tuning needs.

visualization: group-count summary by view and stack depth
interpretation: Flat has the lowest group count by construction, so group count alone is a counterpoint metric, not a localization metric.
